snapshot.text: Mandatory health insurance rolled out nationwide since 2021. In 2026 control of it moved to the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection, and co-financing by patients was postponed to 2027.

priorities.title: Health insurance moves to labour ministry
priorities.text: A new State Agency for Health Insurance and Assessment under the Ministry of Labour and Social Protection takes over mandatory health insurance.

priorities.title: Insurance for informal workers
priorities.text: Azerbaijan introduced mandatory health insurance payments for informal workers.
